thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 장면 대비. 같은 골목에 선 두 과자 공장 — 한쪽은 셔터가 내려지고, 한쪽은 트럭이 드나든다 (추천)
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-saturation HDR street photograph, one single natural scene, eye-level, no split screen. Two unbranded 1990s Korean confectionery factories stand side by side on the same street. The left one is silent: rolling shutter pulled down, gate chained, no lights, faded paint, a few dry leaves at the door. The right one, the same size, is busy: windows glowing warm, workers loading boxes of biscuits onto a delivery truck, steam rising from a vent, hard golden late-afternoon light falling on it. No logos, no signs, no text anywhere. Keep the bottom 35-40% simple and darker for text. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures on metal, glass and water, dust particles and small debris in the air, dramatic volumetric clouds, teal-and-orange color grading, slightly over-processed look.

Through the large glass window behind it, a bright snack production line runs at full speed, biscuits streaming along conveyors under warm golden light, workers in white caps. The contrast between the dim desk and the busy factory floor is the whole story. No logos, no readable text. Keep the bottom 35-40% simple and darker for text. thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic high-saturation HDR image split into three parts. On the left, a dark abandoned 1990s Korean snack factory with dusty cold blue-grey machinery, faded unbranded cookie boxes and lights switched off. In the center, an attractive Korean man in his 50s with a warm likeable face, chest-up close-up filling 60% of the frame height, jaw-dropped and awestruck, looking toward the right side. On the right, a bright working snack factory and production line bathed in golden backlight, glowing rim light and lens flare, freshly baked biscuits streaming along the conveyor, shown larger and closer with a heroic low-angle shot, triumphant mood. No flags, no logos and no brand names on the buildings. Keep the bottom 35-40% darker and simple for text.
